{{Quote|There is a Hidden Dagger heavy transport entering the system that needs to be eliminated.|[[Prisk Kith'Vys]], to a pilot|<ref name="SWG:CtTR" />}}
The '''''Torton Runner''''' was a [[heavy freighter]] owned by the [[Hidden Daggers]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CtTR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the Hidden Daggers obtained sensitive information about [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] operations on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and planned to deliver the data to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. However, the ''Torton Runner'' carrying the sensitive information was attacked in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] by Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] led by [[Prisk Kith'Vys]]. The [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] special unit [[Black Epsilon]] disabled the ''Torton Runner''{{'s}} engines and captured the ship, thereby securing the data.<ref name="SWG:CtTR" />
